_help: MintooSuite partner offers. Edit this file on GitHub (awais_mintoo_cloud/offers.json) and the app shows it within minutes. Each offer: brand, title, text, cat (Exchanges|Brokers|Business|Learning|Services), countries (list of 2-letter codes, or ["*"] for everyone), cities (optional list), url, code (optional promo/referral code), until (optional YYYY-MM-DD). Only add offers you really have an agreement for. They are shown with a Partner label.
